architecture.determinism: Single fit only. Pin versions/seed. Export tree, medians, indicators. Independently verify weighted node moments and best eligible split using saved TRAIN labels; no real-data refit in tests or CI.

labels.fiveTimesOpportunityLossProbability: 5*I(any k in [3,5]: now common-end MFE>=k and next common-end MFE<k OR now exact FAST_WINNER and next_OPEN>now_OPEN)
labels.strict30MAEImprovementPP: next own-entry strict30 MAE minus current own-entry strict30 MAE

architecture.noOracle: No future minimum/maximum entry search. Only current and one scheduled-next purchase evaluation. Missing labels excluded, not failure/zero.
architecture.reason: One bounded joint tree learns limited context interactions for local price/risk improvement. BUY is default and cap forces BUY; no learned SKIP. Opportunity-loss guard protects winners. Unlike v2, no utility-versus-cash comparison or negative trade filtering. No claim of optimal control or calibrated probabilities.
architecture.training: TRAIN baseline common60-complete first-selection symbol-session only. State delays0 and5 (WATCH-eligible); exactly-next5m executable OPEN outcome. Each episode total weight1 across eligible states. Future outcome fields kept in label file only.
architecture.weights: Fixed loss target multiplier5, joint squared_error; no weight/threshold/model rescue.

baseline: B0 FIRST_SELECTOR_ENTRY: first raw selected snapshot, next causally executable scheduled regular OPEN. This counterfactual consumes no Frozen Opportunity Generator. Same primary symbol-session population.
classification: Exact integrated-v1 numeric bands: fraction near.05, pp near.05, count near10; hard floor .5*target for fractions/counts, -.25 for pp; undefined required HARD_FAIL. Composite gates pass/fail. Worst required status. No implicit rescue.
completion: FIRST_RAW_SELECTOR_DIRECT_ENTRY_MEASUREMENT_COMPLETE; preserve result PASS/NEAR_MISS/FAIL/HARD_FAIL, no automatic freeze; STOP after firstValidation/economic/integrity/CI. No DEV TEST/Fresh/OOS/Capital/Portfolio/new EXIT/main merge.

decision.PIT: Policy projection uses raw saved DecisionPrice (known CLOSE) as state reference, not future execution OPEN. Bars end<=t only. Exact score/rank and snapshot timestamp retained. Prefix must be contiguous regular5m from anchor.
decision.execution: After fixed action BUY, scheduled regular bar starting decision timestamp OPEN only. Never completed signal LOW/CLOSE. UNKNOWN_INTRABAR_ORDER maintained. No provider publication latency claim beyond saved completed semantics.
decision.expiry: Only invalid snapshot, session/window boundary, missing completed prefix, or missing executable OPEN. Critical missing state is terminal for symbol-session. Optional feature missing ->TRAIN median+indicator.
decision.rule: If valid and d<10 and next5m decision lies strictly before current window/segment end, WATCH only when predicted price improvement>=.10 AND lossScore/5<=.10 AND predicted strict30 MAE improvement>=0; otherwise BUY_NOW. At cap or last eligible decision BUY_NOW regardless model. No model SKIP, no performance-based expiry.

economicTargets: evaluable>=.90 of complete B0; mean net delta>=.05pp, PF nonworse,p05 nonworse, >=3/4 chronological blocks mean delta>=0, TRAIN top3 exclusion mean delta>0

entryCompositeGates.chronological: At least3/4 blocks complete>=20 and +3/+5>=.80 where denominator exists and mean price improvement>=0
entryCompositeGates.pullback: Combined PB+deep n>=10, price mean>=.10pp, strict30 median improvement>=0,+3 preservation>=.85; ordinary/deep also separately reported
entryCompositeGates.top3Exclusion: Same main targets excluding minimumCompleteN; undefined required fractions FAIL
entryCompositeGates.watchUsed: At least one WATCH and one actual delayed Entry; no route quota tuning

episodes.dedup: One terminal Entry or expiry per symbol-session across all snapshots; repeated selections are universe membership, not independent trade observations. No resurrection after missing/boundary terminal. No EXIT-based reentry.
episodes.history: Only past/current actual Selector snapshots, never future selected count. Whole-session persistence classes are evaluator metadata diagnostics, never runtime features.
episodes.reselection: An actually observed frozen snapshot without symbol followed by selected snapshot. Unobserved5m ticks never count as dropped/reselected. Report continuous/reselection descriptive groups and explicit lunch breaks, not separate funded trades.
episodes.unit: one symbol-session, anchored at first raw selected timestamp

evaluator.classes: exact v1 path_class and v2 fastWinner evaluator with virtual raw-first-selection reference, never features.
evaluator.common: original first-selection+60 clock minutes inside original segment; complete only primary performance. Strict30 from each actual entry. Retain all emitted/critical missing cases.
evaluator.economic: Always compare exact frozen Candidate A with unchanged Fixed12/cost .05pp. Common-baseline IDs paired; nonentry cash0 only if no Entry, missing entered economics UNKNOWN excluded. Report same-entered pairs separately. Shifted EXIT holding horizon not pure price effect.
evaluator.historical: Reuse saved INITIAL/DIP decisions, do not replay/modify generator. INITIAL aligns exact first raw symbol-session; verify IDs/time/prices. DIP is optional secondary event, compare at its exact delay on same original60 endpoint. NO_DIP_EVENT is missing event, not an adopted SKIP policy. All population differences explicit.
evaluator.rawStateDiagnostics: TRAIN only descriptive observed snapshot transitions (score stable/up vs down; rank improvement; price down). Future labels for these diagnostics only from TRAIN, using each raw snapshot own60 window. Repeated observations labelled non-independent, not trades; no candidate/tuning derived after measurement.
evaluator.robustness: Chronological4 blocks from existing dates, TRAIN top3-frequency symbol-session exclusion, continuous/reselection, selected once/2/3+/5+, breadth5 and sessionPart/volatility missing panels. No bad block exclusion/rules.

lineage: New direct raw Selector lineage. Frozen NEW Entry INITIAL/DIP only secondary historical comparison, not candidate input or prerequisite.

universe.filter: No re-ranking, threshold change, symbol blacklist or reduction of window universe.
universe.scope: Every exact raw Top5 is held until next frozen snapshot; price states may change but membership and score/rank do not. Regular-session boundary stops actions; 11:30 snapshot has no executable pre-lunch window; no lunch carry. Last15:00 snapshot ends at saved session end.
